lines.english: "Alright then… Thank you very much, Nori-kun."
"The only ones who still call me that are cabaret hostesses and you…"
"Doesn't that mean there are still quite a few?"
"…Forget that, it's the future that matters, Youko-chan. Your true struggle lies ahead, and so does my true time to shine."
"I'm counting on you, okay? This is the reason I came back to this remote country in the first place."
"I understand that from a business perspective, but you shouldn't describe the home country of someone you have a special bond with as 'remote'…"
"If I used that line of thought for every country, all of them would have a special place in my heart."
"…You never change, do you? With that spirit I can guarantee you another ten years."
"Ten years is not enough. I need another 80. I've made up my mind to live past at least 100 years old."
"…Even this late in the game, you're still inflating the numbers, I see."
"Touma-san, I saw your ride coming."
"Now then, since that's how it is… let's make our next meeting next month."
"At least take an examination once a week. I'll be around during the afternoon on Wednesdays…"
"…Hello. Congratulations on your discharge."
"…Dear me."
Youko-san greets me with a somewhat blank expression after seeing me poke my head out from behind the nurse.
…This might be the first time I've seen that expression of hers.
"Good grief… So this time it's a boyfriend the same age as your daughter? You never change…"
"Huh?"
"…The only thing that never changes is that rotten, perverted brain of yours."
"…Well?"
"We're headed for the studio. Kazusa resumed her practice yesterday."
"That's not what I was asking. Why are you doing Miyo-chan's job, Guitar-kun?"
At first Youko-san was just gawking at me, but once we got in the taxi, she started to leer suspiciously at me.
Well, I suppose that's only natural…
"Kudou-san has her hands tied all day today. She's primarily arranging matters for the additional concert."
"But that doesn't mean…"
"I have permission from the company. I told them I'll be running errands for Touma Youko for a while. I told them that this is the condition for making the additional issue."
"Of course, I haven't said anything about your hospitalization, so don't worry. The chief editor and even my superior were completely convinced, saying 'that's just what Touma Youko would do.'"
"Those guys…"
In times like these, her usual jokester-type personality really is useful.
…After all, I can convince anyone of anything by just saying Touma Youko said so.
"So? What's this about?"
"I thought we should have a meeting about our plans moving forward."
"Moving forward… huh."
She's not just an ordinary troublemaker, but rather a quick-witted, ill-natured troublemaker who knows full well what she's doing. For the first time, that has saved me.
"First and foremost is your illness… Let's keep that fact hidden from others for the time being."
"What about Miyo-chan?"
"I've already spoken to Kudou-san. She was convinced."
"You did all that when the person in question wasn't even around…"
"I told her that we should give our undivided attention to Kazusa's additional concert, and she agreed."
"Well, that was my intention from the start, so I have no objections."
"Moreover, I'd like to minimize contact between you and Kazusa for the time being, Youko-san."
"I suppose it'd be a problem if I collapsed right in front of her."
"The standard should be one hour a day. It'd be best if you just watched her practice in the studio. Please avoid eating with her."
"I have more than ten types of after-meal medication, after all."
No matter how roundabout or blunt I am in my phrasing, she understands the gist of everything I tell her.
"Also, you will have examinations in the hospital three days a week, on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays in the morning. I'll pick you up at the hotel, so avoid staying anywhere besides the hotel."
"Eeh?"
"This is until her additional concert is over. Bear with it until then."
"I'll be fine even if I collapse a few times. Nori-kun will be able to help me even if my heart stops beating."
"Any actions that will reduce your lifespan are strictly forbidden… For Kazusa's sake too."
"What if my condition gets worse because all the fun is sucked from my life?"
"I won't allow that to happen. If you're planning on living for Kazusa's sake, restrain yourself that much."
"At the very least, put yourself under my management until the additional concert is over. Is that okay?"
"So, what about after that…?"
"…That will be decided in a different conference."
My speech, which was eloquent until now, becomes muddled at this point.
"…You plan on attending the conference?"
"…If you can't come up with a conclusion by yourself."
As I suspected, Youko-san's perceptiveness lets her understand everything.
She understands that this schedule doesn't even allude to what will happen after the additional concert is over.
She understands that once three weeks have passed, and Kazusa no longer has a reason to stay in Japan, there will still be no clear solution.
Will she make Kazusa return to Vienna? In that case, will Youko-san stay in Japan?
Will Youko-san tell Kazusa about her illness someday…?
Will she really tell her…?
"Tell me, Guitar-kun… Don't you think that it's unnecessary for you to get involved in this any further?"
"That may be… but I can't just leave it be."
"…What should I do, Guitar-kun?"
Because even Youko-san is at a loss.
"Is it because she was your first woman?"
"Please don't say such unimaginative things."
That's why I can't let Kazusa leave Japan with worrying prospects like that…
"My feelings for her… are that of eternal admiration."
"Admiration… you say."
"That's why I want her to remain cool no matter how much time passes. I want her to become happy…"
"That's why you've decided to make her happy by your own hand? Even when you have rejected the one method she desires more than anything else?"
"…Ah, I spoke out of line. Please forget that."
That could never be happiness for her… No, it wouldn't be happiness for anyone.
Because such a decision would make enemies of the entire world around us.
Not only those we don't ourselves view as enemies, but even those precious to us…
"…Well, let's think about it step by step. After all, it seems I'll have to meet you three times a week from now on."
"…Thank you very much. I look forward to meeting you during the next month."
I'm at a loss too.
That's why I need time. I need time to talk.
The two of us might not be able to come up with anything wise, but I'll give that girl a happy life no matter what it takes…
"Ah, could you go to the convenience store? I want a pack of cigarettes."
"Lifetime ban on smoking from now on."
"…What about alcohol?"
"In moderation."
"Men…?"
"Decide after you've asked yourself if you value him or Kazusa more."
"…I've never seen such a strict manager."
"Haah…"
"Ooh, I heard you injured yourself, but it can't have been anything serious if your performance is anything to go by."
"…Mom."
"Welcome back. How have you been, Kazusa?"
"'Welcome back' is what you say when you've returned before the other person."
"In that case, 'I'm back'?"
"You sure came back early. You must've enjoyed your trip to the hot springs. Or rather, you must've enjoyed being with the person who was with you."
"You're right. He just wouldn't let go of me."
"…T-Thanks to that…!"
"What? Are you still worried about how you got slammed by that critic?"
"I-I'm not…!"
"It's okay, it's okay, that guy is just jealous. He was never a match for me in his heyday, so he's probably trying to satisfy himself by going after my daughter."
"Do you know him?"
"I slept with him twice in the past. And then he…"
"…That's enough. You don't have to say the rest."
"Ah, here's a souvenir. Hamamatsu special unagi pie, Sendai special Hagi no Tsuki, Okinawa special mimigaa, Hokkaido special Marusei Bata Sando."
"…You have a lot of guts enjoying your time in Japan this much."
"It's my home country, after all."
"Though you too were driven out of this country when you were young."
"…Do you hate this country that much?"
"Yeah, I do hate it. I want to get this additional concert over with quickly and return to my home in Vienna."
"Home… you say."
"What are you trying to say?"
"Nooothing."
"Well, I suppose I'll only get in the way of your practice by being here, so I'll be off."
"Aren't you going to criticize my playing?"
"It's just rehabilitating practice, so there's no point. I'll be in the resting room, just give me a call when you're done."
"It'll take another eight hours for me to be done, you know?"
"Make it two hours for today. It'll all come crashing down if your wound reopens."
"Tsk."
"See you then. Do your best, just don't overdo it."
"…Hey."
"Hm?"
"Have you… lost weight?"
"Didn't I tell you? He just wouldn't let me fall asleep."
"Ah…"
"Hey."
In the end, Kazusa left the studio at 8 PM.
Even though I told her that she should take it easy considering her wounds…
"Could it be that… you were waiting here all this time again?"
"No, I just came. I left the office 30 minutes ago, and passed by here in case you were around."
"Really?"
"Yes, really. I swear to both God and the devil."
After all, I made Youko-san leak the information about when Kazusa will leave.
"Hmm…"
Kazusa peers at me from below, with an expression that can both be seen as teasing or expecting.
"Then let me check."
"…Do as you wish."
She envelops my right hand with both her hands.
Again, she touches both sides of my hand with her stiff fingers, and gently caresses them.
Kazusa's hands are warm. In fact, you could even call them hot.
Perhaps it was due to her passionate practice up until now, or perhaps the result of an inflammation in her injured hands. I can't think of any other reason…
"…Huh?"
"Didn't I tell you? I just came."
"Kazusa…?"
Instead of her hands, she brings her face closer to my chest for some reason.
"H-Hey…?"
"You said you didn't care if anyone saw, didn't you? Lend me your chest for a while."
"Hey… that doesn't mean you should all of a sudden…"
"…Then let's go. I'm really tired today."
…Before I can even process what is happening, she pulls away in an instant with a completely different expression, then she walks away as if nothing happened.
"What's the matter with you…?"
Just like usual, she's terrible at conveying her feelings through her actions. Or perhaps it's more appropriate to say that her actions sometimes make no sense at all.
"Hey, Haruki… You don't have to pick me up anymore."
"What do you want to eat today? …Though the only choices are curry, chicken stew, Korean stew, oden, and pot-au-feu."
As you'd expect of a sad man living alone, I have no confidence making any food that isn't stew.
"My hands have healed, so I'll be returning to the hotel soon."
"But we had water-boiled chicken yesterday, and we've had curry three times now. Kazusa, choose between meat and fish today…"
"You don't have to keep looking after me all the time. Don't you have a job?"
"Yeah, I do. My job is to write a special number on Touma Kazusa."
"The truth is, the final checking of the articles will take a while if I do it at the office, so I wanted to do it directly…"
No matter how much I try to change the topic, Kazusa just refuses to get a clue.
That's why I opt for a different strategy, facing her head-on and attempting to shave off the strength of her words.
"…Don't be kind to me anymore."
Unfortunately, I wouldn't just be toning down the tension. The amount of damage she would receive really makes me not want to resort to this tactic.
"…But you can't live alone, can you? You don't have any attendants here anymore."
"I can… I got by just fine even while I was overseas."
"Getting by isn't enough. You have a concert coming up soon. You need to be in your best form."
"I am in my best form. It's nothing for you to worry about…"
"What about food? Can you eat three balanced meals a day?"
"I promise. I'll eat breakfast, lunch and dinner… with lots of vegetables, and moderate sugar."
"What about caring for your hands? You'll have to go on about your days with your injury in mind."
"I'll go to the hospital every day after practice. I'll even regularly change my compress."
"What about your measures against the mass media? Will you be able to respond to rude people surrounding you with a smile on your face?"
"See, I can't trust you after all. That's why I keep telling you that you need a manager."
"I don't need such a thing! I can make do by myself! At the very least, I don't need you anymore!"
"You say that, but you utterly failed your last concert."
"That was only because you refused to come! …Ah."
"Told you."
"Why didn't you come to listen to my piano…?"
"As long as you want me to, I'll do my very best for you, Kazusa… This time, I'll be by your side."
That statement may be arrogant, presumptuous… and excessive.
But despite that, the both painful and happy fact that it works on Kazusa is evident.
"That's why it's okay for you to remain in that apartment. Until the concert is over, it's okay for you to stay there."
"Until… the concert is over?"
"Yeah…"
Until the concert is over, I won't leave Kazusa's side.
That can also be interpreted as me not making any promises about what will happen after the concert…
"Why…?"
"Because I want your concert to succeed. I want the people of Japan to understand your greatness."
Kazusa realizes the deceit behind those words. She realizes that I'm still taking a step back.
"I want you to come to like Japan once again…"
But I have no choice but to separate my feelings from what I need to do.
Even if she manages to see through my cowardly behavior. And even if that means she'll run out of patience with me.
There is a truth I need to hide from her, even if it means using a despicable version of myself as a front.
"…tew."
"Eh?"
And in response to that, Kazusa…
"I'm sick of stew. I've had enough of curry too… I want meat, a thick steak."
"Kazusa…"
…Bears with me for another while longer.
"I see, you want steak. Yes, making that should be a piece of cake… no, you should probably avoid cake."
"I hope you're not underestimating steak. Don't think you can satisfy me just by roasting some meat."
"Leave it to me. Rare, medium and well-done are all my fortes. I can even do flambe if you want… not that I've ever done it."
"…I have a bad feeling about this, but let's see what you've got."
"Alright, let's buy some meat at the underground department store along the way, okay? I'll get something expensive like sirloin."
"That's why I keep calling you poor. How can you use sirloin and 'good meat' in the same sentence?"
I still don't know if she decided that she still needs me, or if she just gave up on trying to convince me that she doesn't.
Regardless, she'll allow me to meddle in her affairs… something that should be nothing but torture to Kazusa.
That's why I'll make Kazusa suffer with all my might… and from the bottom of my heart.
Until her last concert in Japan. Until three weeks from now…
"…Also, if you're going to the department store, get a dozen of Rascal's smooth pudding."
"Not a minute ago you told me you'd avoid sweet food."
Kazusa, Youko-san and me… thus begins our life on a tightrope that may snap at any moment. A tightrope smeared with lies, hypocrisy, and makeshift solutions.
"Kazusa's practicing again."
"I've got some good news today. Kazusa is resuming her practice now."
"Her injury isn't fully healed, but it seems most of the pain is gone. She says that the rest of the healing can happen as she reaccustoms herself to playing the piano."
"I wish from the bottom of my heart that doing so will lead her in a good direction."
"I've caused you a lot of worry until now, Setsuna. But I'd be overjoyed if you could partake in the happiness over seeing this progress happen."
"…Though, starting with the good news will make what I'm about to say much harder…"
"This year… I might not be able to celebrate your birthday."
"Right now, I think that Kazusa needs my support in order to focus on her concert."
"That might sound excessively arrogant, but right now I simply can't pull back. I'm sorry."
"Let me apologize in advance for now. Goodbye."
